description: This file defines the ADODB2_sybase class, which extends ADODB_DataDict to implement database schema manipulation functions specifically for Sybase databases within the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It includes methods for type mapping, SQL generation for altering tables, creating indexes, and managing columns, as well as related constants and configuration.

classes.name: ADODB2_sybase
classes.description: A class for handling Sybase-specific database schema operations, extending the generic ADODB_DataDict class to include Sybase-specific SQL syntax and data type mappings.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps a PHP field type to a Sybase-specific meta type identifier.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts a meta type identifier into a Sybase-compatible SQL data type string.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add new columns to a specified table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter existing columns in a specified table.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a specified table.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Constructs a column definition suffix string for CREATE/ALTER TABLE statements based on column attributes.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements for creating or dropping an index on a table.
